Space Invaders

Quick start guide for Windows, Linux, and macOS

Before you start

This game requires Java 17 or newer.

Open a terminal or Command Prompt and check with:

java -version

If Java is missing or older than version 17, install Java 17 or newer and try again.

Windows

  1. Open the extracted game folder.
  2. Open the bin folder.
  3. Double-click space_invaders.bat.

Linux

Open a terminal in the extracted game folder and run:

./bin/space_invaders

If you see “Permission denied,” run:

chmod +x bin/space_invaders
./bin/space_invaders

macOS

  1. Open Terminal.
  2. Type cd , including the space.
  3. Drag the extracted game folder into Terminal and press Return.
  4. Run ./bin/space_invaders.

If you see “Permission denied,” first run chmod +x bin/space_invaders.

Controls

  • F2: Start the game
  • Left/Right arrow: Move the ship
  • Spacebar: Fire
  • Alt + Enter: Toggle fullscreen
  • Escape: Exit

Troubleshooting

  • Extract the ZIP before running the game.
  • Keep the bin and lib folders together.
  • Confirm that java -version reports version 17 or newer.
